description: This Java source file defines a WearableListenerService named ListenerService that handles data change events and message events from wearable devices, and displays notifications related to tourist attractions.

classes.name: ListenerService
classes.description: A service extending WearableListenerService to handle data and message events from wearable devices, and to show notifications about attractions.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles data change events from wearable devices, triggers notification display when attraction data is received.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, clears notifications if a specific path is received.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a notification with attraction details, including loading a bitmap asset and setting up intents.
